title: Dragonmaw Gates
wikitext:
[[Image:Dragonmaw Gates.jpg|thumb|Dragonmaw Gates]]
[[Dragonmaw Gates]] are a set of grandoise portals that block the winding path leading up to [[Grim Batol]]. The gates are guarded by several different types of [[dragonkin]] of the red dragonflight, as well as the powerful drake [[Axtroz]]. It is possible to pass through the gates and survive, but past the last gate, the area just below the mountain is completely deserted. It is possible this area will contain a red dragon later in the game's development.
